main_body: Leafy tree canopy (large rounded green mass, rows ~1-36) on a thin brown trunk (rows 36-44) with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Organic canopy: lighter green clumps at the upper part of the crown (rows ~4-16) shade down to darker greens at the lower edge; no flat rectangular top band, but the crown reads as a rounded volume lit from above
evidence: Organic tree: a rounded canopy with lighter leaf clumps on top and darker, shadowed foliage toward the bottom, then a trunk standing on a grass/soil patch. The dark underside of the crown over the trunk acts as the shading below the canopy. It reads as a volume seen from slightly above, not a flat elevation, and has no receding side faces. The organic kind does not require a hard-edged top plane.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens in clumped patches with a dark-green edge that is tinted green rather than black, so the outline is acceptable. The trunk is a small, simple 3-tone brown column with a flat dark base, and the grass patch is flat dark green with few variations. Next to the references, which have individual leaf clusters with bright highlights, branches visible inside the crown, and root flare, the candidate is a smoother blob with fewer distinct leaf shapes and a thin trunk. Tile density is a little lower than the reference, and the piece looks slightly flatter and simpler beside them.
